title: Example 2-4: Copyright Year

illustrates.quote: d. Copyright Notices (1) Use the copyright symbol when it appears in print. Follow print for spacing. (2) Only the most recent copyright date and copyright holder are placed on the title page of each volume. All other dates are ignored.
